rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for an embarrassing or socially uncomfortable situation.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 coeng4 hap6 zan1 hai6 hou2 gaam1 gaai3

rows.note: Use this when someone feels or behaves uncomfortable and unnatural in social interaction.

example.english: I always feel awkward when I chat with my new colleagues.
example.traditional: 我同新同事傾計嗰陣成日覺得唔自然。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 san1 tung4 si6 king1 gai2 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 gok3 dak1 m4 zi6 jin4

rows.note: Use this specifically for someone who is clumsy with their hands or movements.

example.english: I was awkward with my hands the first time I made a cake.
example.traditional: 我第一次整蛋糕，成日都笨手笨腳。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 zing2 daan6 gou1 seng4 jat6 dou1 ban6 sau2 ban6 goek3

rows.note: Use this for a person or situation that is difficult, troublesome, or hard to deal with.

example.english: This customer is really awkward to deal with.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 haak3 zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 gaau2
